events.title: Major Demo Update: Meet Tithe, Feed Marrow, and Plan Your Shop Better
events.summary: What's New: This is one of the biggest demo updates for The Totemist so far.The headline addition is Tithe, a new character who introduces himself the first time you forget to buy binding kits. If you run out, Tithe gives you a way to buy more immediately at an extremely marked-up price. The idea is simple: you can pay for convenience, or plan ahead and avoid the cost.Tithe also brings a new shop preview menu while you’re in the workshop.
